video.title: Openclaw AI explained - What is OpenClaw and how it works?

transcript.text: Open Claw, also known as Claw Bot, or
Mold book, is one of the fastest growing
AI open source projects with more GitHub
stars than Kubernetes. So, let's
understand what is Open Claw and how
does it work? So, Open Claw is an open
source framework for building AI agents
that can take real actions directly from
messaging applications like WhatsApp or
Telegram. So, instead of clicking on
dashboards or writing automation
scripts, you can simply send a message
to your agent describing what you want.
You can do tasks like sending an email,
booking tickets, pushing code,
triggering workflows, or pretty much
anything that you do manually. But, how
does it work? From a technical point of
view, Open Claw works by connecting
large language model with different
available tools. Open Claw already
provides you with a set of built-in
tools, but you can also create your own
custom tools based on your needs. Now,
when you send a request to an agent
through Telegram, it will understand
what you want to do and then use the
tools to get the job done. The best part
is, since Open Claw is open source, you
can also deploy it locally on your
machine. If you want a complete video on
how to set up Open Claw in your local
machine using Docker and Ollama, comment
below Open Claw and I will create a
step-by-step video. Subscribe.
